newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Yukong shares go limit up.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yukong shares go limit up.

text.p: Shares of Yukong Ltd, South Korea's largest oil refiner, rose to their upper limits in Tuesday morning trading on active foreign buying, brokers said.
The share price rose 1,200 won, or 5.71 percent, to 22,200 won.
"Yukong is rising because the shares are seen to be so cheap these days," said Lee Sang-koo, an analyst with Hyundai Securities.
News that Yukong had developed a pollution filter for automobiles that could cut toxic emmissions by up to 90 percent has also excited investors, market watchers said.
